brief:
Hundreds of demonstrators gathered Sunday in the Greek capital to protest military and diplomatic ties between Athens and Israel, Shehab Wire reported. The protesters assembled in Monastiraki Square, one of central Athens's main public spaces, to voice solidarity with Palestine and call for an end to bilateral cooperation between the Greek government and the Israeli state.

The demonstration reflects mounting pressure on European governments to reconsider their relationship with Israel. Organizers and participants emphasized their opposition to military and diplomatic engagement, framing the action as part of broader efforts to isolate Israeli institutions through coordinated grassroots mobilization across multiple countries.
title: Hundreds march in Athens demanding Greece halt cooperation with Israel
